## 主张 Claim

前 n 项自然数承担的每个所选子集都不超过 reserve，当且仅当全部承担之和不超过 reserve。 / Every selected subset of the first n natural-number obligations fits reserve iff their full sum fits reserve.

Canonical source: [CorrectionDependence.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/meta-attractor/CorrectionDependence.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 承担为非负自然数且可加，reserve 为同一份可用支持。 / Obligations are nonnegative additive natural numbers; reserve is the same available support pool.

数值代表所声明的退出工作，不是通用伦理价值；真实义务与储备需独立核实。 / Numbers represent declared exit work, not universal ethical value; actual obligations and reserves require independent correspondence.
